draw.method: random.Random(52941119). Shippable = candidate 'likely' groups whose category is not held (junkyard_scraper._oem_held / GROUP_HOLD_CATS): 225 of 228 (3 wiper-motor held). Ids sorted within each category; quota = largest remainder of 30*n_cat/225; rng.sample per category in sorted category order; then rng.sample(30) of the remaining 195 sorted ids; per pair group the vehicle-years are expanded from apps and sorted, seeker = rng.choice, donor = rng.choice of the rest.
